## Downloads {#downloads}

Start with `MATISSE_toolbox.zip` and the Overview live script. Next, open The Lexis Diagram live script. The user's guide is a growing set of MATLAB live scripts (`.mlx`) with companion PowerPoint slides. Use the slides to review the concepts and the live scripts to run the code. The available files are listed below.

| File                                                                                                 | Description                                                                                                                                       | Size   |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| [MATISSE_toolbox.zip](downloads/MATISSE_toolbox.zip)                                                 | The toolbox itself: all classes (`@apc`, `@rates`, `@sage`, …), graphics and statistics functions, and the 16 example SEER datasets               | 0.9 MB |
| [MATISSE_1_Overview.mlx](downloads/MATISSE_1_Overview.mlx)                                           | User's guide 1: design philosophy, object model, system map, help system, graphics options                                                        | 1.2 MB |
| [MATISSE_2_The_Lexis_Diagram.mlx](downloads/MATISSE_2_The_Lexis_Diagram.mlx)                         | User's guide 2: the `rates` class, `pcolor`/`surf`/`lexis` methods, comparing multiple Lexis diagrams                                             | 2.6 MB |
| [Statistical_Methods_in_CSR.pptx](downloads/Statistical_Methods_in_CSR.pptx)                         | Course slides: statistical methods in cancer surveillance research                                                                                | 1.0 MB |
| [The_Lexis_Diagram.pptx](downloads/The_Lexis_Diagram.pptx)                                           | Course slides: the Lexis diagram                                                                                                                  | 3.1 MB |
| [SEER_CI5plus_to_APC_WebTool.pptx](downloads/SEER_CI5plus_to_APC_WebTool.pptx)                       | Course slides: from SEER/CI5+ data to the APC web tool                                                                                            | 1.8 MB |
| [Miranda-Filho_Rosenberg_2024_FrontOncol.pdf](downloads/Miranda-Filho_Rosenberg_2024_FrontOncol.pdf) | Miranda Filho & Rosenberg, *Advances in statistical methods for cancer surveillance research: an age-period-cohort perspective*, Front Oncol 2024 | 4.4 MB |
| [Rosenberg_2023_BMCMedResMethodol.pdf](downloads/Rosenberg_2023_BMCMedResMethodol.pdf)               | Comparative age-period-cohort analysis reference (BMC Med Res Methodol 2023)                                                                      | 6.2 MB |

## FAQ {#faq}

**Do I need to buy MATLAB to use MATISSE?**
You can use MATLAB Online in your browser. Sign in with a MathWorks account and check the current access terms. Follow [Getting started with MATLAB Online](getting-started.html#getting-started-with-matlab-online) to set up the toolbox. You need a MATLAB license to use a local copy.

**Do I need to know MATLAB already?**
Some familiarity helps. Start with the Overview live script to learn how the toolbox works. Run one section at a time and inspect the result. Use [Getting help](toolbox-guide.html#getting-help) when a command is unfamiliar.

**Is MATISSE peer reviewed / published?**
The methods are described in Miranda Filho & Rosenberg, *Advances in statistical methods for cancer surveillance research: an age-period-cohort perspective* (Front Oncol, 2024). Download the paper from [Downloads](#downloads). For individual methods, such as SAGE and comparative APC analysis, open [Related methods and publications](#related-methods-and-publications).

**How do I ask a question or get help?**
Send us an email at [matisse.apc@gmail.com](mailto:matisse.apc@gmail.com). For quick answers about commands, use the toolbox's built-in help. See [Getting help](toolbox-guide.html#getting-help) for the commands.

**Will the live sessions be recorded?**
Yes. Recordings will be linked here when they are available.
